_about: DRAFT for the play-tester's review, nothing built yet. The in-game settings menu (SkyUI MCM through MCM Helper; a hidden quest in MordhauWeapons.esp, its one-line script compiled with the Creation Kit). MCM Helper finds the menu by the plugin's name: the pages are Data/MCM/Config/MordhauWeapons/config.json with the defaults in settings.ini beside it (tools/make_mcm.py makes both from this sheet), and the player's choices are kept in Data/MCM/Settings/MordhauWeapons.ini; the plugin reads them when the menu closes and at each load, and each one replaces the sheet value named in 'acts_on' (the sheet value stays the default). play-test note, 2026-10-15. 'new' = the setting does not exist in the mod yet and has to be added; = how it can be done is not known yet.

rows.label: Damage you deal
rows.acts_on: new: multiplies the health fraction the player's MORDHAU-judged hits take (progression.json formula)
rows.help: How much health your hits take, on top of the mod's own balance. 1 = unchanged.

rows.label: Damage you take
rows.acts_on: new: multiplies the health fraction hits on the player take
rows.help: How much health hits on you take. 1 = unchanged.

rows.label: How much your armour protects
rows.acts_on: progression.json armour_share (share of Skyrim's own armour reduction)
rows.help: How much of Skyrim's own armour reduction protects you from MORDHAU hits. 0 = armour does nothing, 1 = all of it.

rows.label: Clean hits to kill an equal
rows.acts_on: progression.json hits_to_kill
rows.help: Clean hits that kill someone of your level with an ordinary weapon. Fewer = deadlier fights.

rows.label: Level difference matters
rows.acts_on: off = progression.json level_min and level_max taken as 1
rows.help: On: higher-level fighters hit harder and take more hits. Off: level makes no difference.

rows.label: Damage to creatures
rows.acts_on: builds.json creature_damage_scale
rows.help: Damage your hits do to creatures (wolves, draugr, trolls...).

rows.label: Kick damage to creatures
rows.acts_on: builds.json kick_creature_damage
rows.help: How much your kick hurts creatures and anyone without a MORDHAU fighter, as a share of a clean weapon hit. 0 = kicks do no damage.

rows.label: Super kick
rows.acts_on: builds.json super_kick
rows.help: Your kick throws whoever it reaches away from you, like Fus Ro Dah. Not dragons.

rows.label: Super kick force
rows.acts_on: builds.json super_kick_force
rows.help: How hard the super kick throws.

rows.label: Enemy skill at equal level
rows.acts_on: the F8 menu's enemy skill level (CombatStandIns SetAiLevel, cache/ai_level.txt): changed here, it is taken; the last one changed, F8 or this, counts. play-test note, 2026-10-15.
rows.help: How well enemies of your own level fight: parrying, feinting, how soon they attack. The same choice as the F8 menu in game.

rows.label: Enemy skill follows the level gap
rows.acts_on: sheets/enemy_ai.json level_skill: on = from the chosen level at equal levels to Duelist at 19 above and Peasant at 19 below, blended between the five levels; off = the chosen level for everyone. Named enemies one level up either way.
rows.help: On: enemies 19 or more levels above you fight like duelists, 19 or more below like peasants, at your own level as chosen above, smoothly in between. Off: everyone fights at the level chosen above. Named enemies are one level better either way.

rows.label: MORDHAU fighters within (metres)
rows.acts_on: builds.json standin_radius_m. play-test note, 2026-10-16
rows.help: Everyone fighting within this distance of you fights by MORDHAU's rules (up to the number below), allies included. Larger makes more of a battle MORDHAU's but costs both games speed.

rows.label: MORDHAU fighters at once
rows.acts_on: builds.json standin_limit (the plugin takes the nearest that many; MORDHAU's script writes only the places in use). play-test note, 2026-10-16
rows.help: How many of the people around you fight by MORDHAU's rules at the same time, nearest first. More makes big battles feel more like MORDHAU but costs both games speed; if characters start to move in jerks, lower it.

rows.label: Your yells and grunts
rows.acts_on: the player's CharacterVoiceComponent: off = MORDHAU's muffled switch with the muffled volume at 0 (as the stand-ins are muted); on = the mercenary's own muffled volume back.
rows.help: Your character's MORDHAU yells, grunts and pain sounds.

rows.label: Enemies' MORDHAU voices
rows.acts_on: builds.json standin_voices; passed to MORDHAU's script (PS_STANDIN_VOICES) with the voice as VoiceSet<n>
rows.help: MORDHAU yells and death screams from the people you fight. Off: they only speak as Skyrim has them speak.

rows.label: Hit sound and marker on creatures
rows.acts_on: builds.json hit_marker
rows.help: MORDHAU's hit sound and marker when you hit a creature.

rows.label: Keep MORDHAU audible behind Skyrim
rows.acts_on: builds.json mordhau_background_audio (read before MORDHAU starts: takes effect at the next start)
rows.help: MORDHAU mutes itself while its window is behind Skyrim. On: the mod turns that off for its own session. Takes effect at the next Skyrim start.

rows.label: Sound style
rows.acts_on: new: picks MORDHAU's volume and Skyrim's weapon sounds at once (plugin SoundMix); 'Custom' takes the sliders. play-test note, 2026-10-15. 2026-10-15: 'Both in full' (then the default) taken out - the sliders did nothing until 'Custom' was chosen ; the sliders always count unless one of the two 'Only' styles is chosen.
rows.help: Only MORDHAU: Skyrim's weapon sounds are silent. Only Skyrim: MORDHAU is silent (also its voices). Otherwise the sliders below count.

rows.label: MORDHAU volume
rows.acts_on: MORDHAU's script (main.lua PS_apply_volume), sent as Volume<percent>: GameplayStatics SetSoundMixClassOverride on MORDHAU's GlobalMasterSoundClass through its GlobalMasterSoundMix, in the mod's session only - MORDHAU's saved sound settings are never touched. Tried in the D: test 2026-10-15 (20%). With a sound style other than Custom: the style's own (both / only MORDHAU: 100%, only Skyrim: 0) - plugin SoundMix::MordhauVolume.
rows.help: How loud MORDHAU is: its swings, clashes, hits and voices.

rows.label: Skyrim weapon hits
rows.acts_on: Skyrim's own weapon sounds of the kind 'hits' (sheets/skyrim_combat_sounds.json: weapon hits (on flesh, armour, wood, stone)) - each record's static attenuation raised in memory (plugin SoundMix::ApplySkyrim); used with the style Custom.
rows.help: How loud Skyrim's own weapon hits (on flesh, armour, wood, stone) are.

rows.label: Skyrim weapon swings
rows.acts_on: Skyrim's own weapon sounds of the kind 'swings' (sheets/skyrim_combat_sounds.json: weapon swings) - each record's static attenuation raised in memory (plugin SoundMix::ApplySkyrim); used with the style Custom.
rows.help: How loud Skyrim's own weapon swings are.

rows.label: Skyrim blocks and bashes
rows.acts_on: Skyrim's own weapon sounds of the kind 'blocks' (sheets/skyrim_combat_sounds.json: blocks and bashes) - each record's static attenuation raised in memory (plugin SoundMix::ApplySkyrim); used with the style Custom.
rows.help: How loud Skyrim's own blocks and bashes are.

rows.label: Skyrim drawing and sheathing
rows.acts_on: Skyrim's own weapon sounds of the kind 'draw' (sheets/skyrim_combat_sounds.json: weapon drawing and sheathing sounds) - each record's static attenuation raised in memory (plugin SoundMix::ApplySkyrim); used with the style Custom.
rows.help: How loud Skyrim's own weapon drawing and sheathing sounds are.

rows.label: Your character's voice
rows.acts_on: MORDHAU's script (main.lua PS_apply_voice; its list PS_VOICES must be voice_assets, in this order): the player's character's CharacterVoiceComponent.CharacterVoice = /Game/Mordhau/Blueprints/Voices/BP_<asset>. The names shown are MORDHAU's own (each voice's ItemName, read from the game 2026-10-15; '(female)' added where a female voice shares a male one's name). play-test note, 2026-10-15, on a first entry 'Your mercenary's own': removed - only MORDHAU's voices are listed, Eager first chosen (the default mercenary's voice). Sent with the others as VoiceSet<n>, as the list position + 1.
rows.help: Your character's MORDHAU voice, by MORDHAU's own names.

rows.label: Voice pitch
rows.acts_on: the player's CharacterVoiceComponent.VoicePitch, kept within the chosen voice's own PitchLimits (MORDHAU's: e.g. Foppish 0.77-1.02, Irish 0.82-1.15, Eager 0.85-1.05).
rows.help: Your character's voice pitch. Each voice has its own range in MORDHAU; outside it the nearest pitch the voice allows is used.

pages._note: named 'Voice' the page came up empty in game (2026-10-15): Skyrim's interface has a word 'Voice' of its own and showed 'voice', which MCM Helper did not find

rows.label: Crouch
rows.acts_on: the input handler (CombatInternal.h, sneak): Toggle = Skyrim's sneak untouched; Hold = held to crouch, let go to stand (live_input.json crouch_hold). MORDHAU's character follows Skyrim's sneaking either way. 2026-10-16: a streamer hammered Ctrl - with hold every tap crouched and stood up at once .
rows.help: Toggle: tap your Sneak key to crouch and tap again to stand, as in Skyrim. Hold: crouched while the key is held, as in MORDHAU.

rows.label: Enemies never yield or flee
rows.acts_on: builds.json fought_no_retreat
rows.help: On: the people you fight never yield or run away (only Skyrim's essential characters still go down on one knee).

rows.label: Kicks stagger creatures
rows.acts_on: builds.json kick_stagger
rows.help: Your kick staggers creatures and anyone without a MORDHAU fighter.

rows.label: Arrows stay stuck (seconds)
rows.acts_on: builds.json arrow_stays_seconds
rows.help: How long your arrows and bolts stay stuck where they hit.

rows.label: Hide your helmet when looking down
rows.acts_on: off = camera.json eye_head_hidden_looking_down taken as never
rows.help: Hides your helmet while you look far down in first person, so it does not block the view.

rows.label: Weapons knocked away
rows.acts_on: builds.json disarm_mode (0 / 1; -1, the old copy on the ground, is not offered). play-test note, 2026-10-25
rows.help: Drop: a weapon knocked out of a hand falls to the ground and leaves the inventory - its owner takes it back standing on it, or anyone picks it up. Stay: it is put away in the inventory and comes back to the hand after the lockout below.

rows.label: Lockout after a disarm (seconds)
rows.acts_on: builds.json disarm_lockout_seconds
rows.help: With 'Stay in the inventory': how long a knocked-away weapon cannot be taken up again, yours and the enemies'.

rows.label: Start MORDHAU with Skyrim
rows.acts_on: Session.cpp: off = the plugin starts no session, as MordhauSkyrim.ini StartMordhau=0 (read once at Skyrim's start; only another reason not to start, never one to start). Safety tests run on it.
rows.help: Off: the mod never starts MORDHAU and Skyrim plays as usual. Takes effect at the next Skyrim start.
